strategic_chain.what_viewer_saw: A half-inch tall American cockroach sprints straight into a 3.2 mm crack (two stacked pennies) and vanishes in under a second.
strategic_chain.physical_mechanism: Rigid chitin plates shingle on soft folding arthrodial hinges (~47% compression) while >80-degree leg sprawl lifts the foot claws and engages backward-pointing tibial shin spines like crampons.
strategic_chain.supporting_evidence: Jayaram & Full (2016) PNAS 500 fps experiments across n = 21 male Periplaneta americana: 315 crevice-gate trials, 104 ceiling-height corridor trials, 638 confined-friction runs, and cyclic compression tests.
strategic_chain.what_evidence_does_not_prove: Does NOT prove cockroaches are indestructible under sharp point loads, does NOT generalize exact 3.2 mm / 4.0 mm thresholds to every cockroach species, and our 3D visuals are illustrative reconstructions rather than lab video.
strategic_chain.viewer_understanding_shift: Replaces the myth of 'rubbery or indestructible pests' with two exact mechanical design principles: hinged armor that folds and spiny shins that take over when feet lose geometry.
